thread:
Alex: Heads-up — I see latency regressions when enabling the new FP8 kernels on small seq lengths (<=32) in staging. Profiling attached.
Marie: Can you paste the flame graph / perf numbers?
Alex: Quick numbers: median latency up ~18% for seq=16, p95 up ~35%. Kernel switch shows more gmem stalls with fp8_fast.
Sanjay: That's the fp8 kernel path that uses fused MATMUL+DP. Calibration might be producing bad quant scales for small batches.
Marie: Could be KV cache alignment — FP8 reduces precision on KV and the runtime's chunking ends up misaligned. We saw similar with int8 earlier.
Alex: Repro script: 
```
# run with sdk flag
resp = client.generate(model='rwkv-large', quant={'mode':'fp8_fast', 'calibrate':'per-layer', 'presets':['aggressive']})
``` 
Alex: With calibrate=per-tensor things look stable but slower.
Jo: We shouldn't expose 'aggressive' as default. Suggest two presets: 'safe' and 'throughput'. 'safe' => int8 or fp8_auto with per-tensor calibrate, fallback to int8 when latency>threshold. 'throughput' => fp8_fast, aggressive cache packing.
Marie: Also add server-side guardrail: if recent telemetry shows generation_latency_growth>10% vs baseline, runtime forces fallback and emits warning event.
Sanjay: For SDK API propose:
```
quant = {
  'preset': 'safe',        # 'safe'|'throughput'|'custom'
  'mode': None,           # override: 'fp8_fast'|'int8'|'4bit'
  'calibration': 'auto',  # 'auto'|'per-layer'|'per-tensor'
  'safety': {'latency_threshold_ms': 25, 'fallback': 'int8'}
}
client.generate(..., quant=quant)
```
Marie: Also doc note: calibration may take 1-3 warmup batches; performance numbers should be measured after steady-state. Add example benchmarking snippet.
Alex: For release we need: SDK param, docs + examples, runtime telemetry guardrail, and an integration test that exercises short/long seq and verifies fallback correctness.
Jo: I'll file a short RFC and add a test plan. tagging @devops for perf infra. :white_check_mark:
DevBot: Deploy check: canary runtime with fp8_fast on dedicated pool completed — 2/4 nodes passed additional regression tests.
Alex: Thanks — I'll drop the perf log in #eng-runtime later.
